name: Trnava (Slovakia)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, the yellow the wider, charged towards the hoist with a yellow six-spoked wheel outlined in blue, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature T-8/91.
